GODS EROTIC. enthronement is set in a world dominated by women.

Most children are female, while the few males born with spiritual bones are taken away by immortals for training.

The Marquis of the West, JiChang leads the people in a rebellion against the Shang dynasty, eventually establishing the Zhou dynasty.

The protagonist, Taigong Wang, is tasked with assisting King Wen and King Wu of Zhou in their mission against King Zhou, embarking on an adventure filled with challenges and temptations.

• Taigong Wang: The protagonist of GODS EROTIC. enthronement. 
At the age of 32, he ascended Mount Kunlun to study under the Master of the Primordial, though he did not attain immortality. He was sent down the mountain to execute the divine plan. Although Taigong Wang is not skilled in martial arts, he possesses a magical whip, which intimidates all women.

◼︎ Game introduction
The goal of this game is to build a soaring tower of ascension.
Besides aiming for higher scores, the main objective of the game is to give the Megami "pleasure".
After experiencing pleasure, the Megamis will reward players with "Megami Coins" based on their scores.
In skill menu, in the game over screen, and when reaching high altitude, Megamis will have different appearances.
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43921064/14ea0cf035e451278d14283a7a0e690314c3ba44.gif[/img]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43921064/6dfee0edf12d93f9f2ff4ae4708a3684b71a9a07.png[/img]

Every ten layers stacked with "bars" will trigger the skill menu.
In the skill menu, three out of six Megami skills will randomly appear.
Players must choose one from them.
Some skills last until the next skill selection, while others last until the end of the run.
